verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a stacked Darkness Rise or get isolated by Realm of Death at level 6; you win by farming through Vorpal Blade sustain and Feint absorption until items let you out-scale him.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Obliterate (Q) out-damages anything Shen can answer with in a short trade, and his passive Darkness Rise snowballs the longer a fight runs, so Shen cannot win a straight fight in this lane. The only viable plan is disengaging onto Q (Vorpal Blade) sustain and W (Feint) absorption until Titanic Hydra and boots let Shen pressure through taunts instead of trading damage.

theirWindow.what: Disengage completely. Autoing into a stacked Darkness Rise aura trades terribly. If you must stand, Feint (W) absorbs the Obliterate hit, but back off before his third proc on you lands.

yourWindow.when: His Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: Step in with an auto plus Vorpal Blade (Q). With no Obliterate or Death's Grasp available he can't punish the trade or re-engage before you reset to minions.

powerCurve.note: Realm of Death can solo you

start.why: Measured at 49.1% WR over 108 games and 50.7% pick — the sustain and early poke reduction matters against Obliterate's single-target burst.

boots.why: 67.9% pick and 50.4% WR over 131 games. Mordekaiser's damage is magic, so the MR directly reduces every Obliterate and Death's Grasp tick.

core.why: Core starting item in every winning path (57-85.7% WR across sampled builds) — the health-scaling and wave clear let you farm safely under his poke.
Second item in every recorded core path on this matchup.
57.1% WR over 7 games as the third item — the magic shield directly answers Mordekaiser's all-magic damage profile.

situational.when: he is leaning on Indestructible's self-heal and you need grievous wounds to shut it off
their team has additional heavy magic damage beyond Mordekaiser
the game goes long and you want more HP scaling for split-pushing
their team's damage shifts mostly physical and 60.4% WR boots (over a smaller 48-game sample) outweighs the MR from Mercury's Treads

runes.keystoneWhy: 54.7% WR and the most-picked page (35.9%) — the sustained-trade healing and max-HP growth are built for a lane you're meant to survive, not win outright.

summoners.why: 54.5% WR at 64.1% pick, the best-performing combo recorded for this matchup — Ignite punishes the rare all-in window when his Indestructible shield is already spent.

playing.title: Feint through Obliterate
playing.detail: Feint (W, 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown) shields and absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds — use it on his Obliterate casts to blunt trades rather than hoarding it for an all-in that rarely comes.

playing.title: Never eat his third hit
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on you, granting him a damage aura and move speed. Disengage before that third proc, not after.

playing.title: Hold Shadow Dash for punishes
playing.detail: E (16/14/12/10/8s cooldown, 575 range) taunts on contact but only deals minor damage — use it to punish his used Obliterate or Death's Grasp, not to open a trade he out-damages.

playing.title: Respect level 6 isolation
playing.detail: Realm of Death banishes you into a private duel and steals your stats permanently on a kill. Never give him a clean level-6 engage when you're low or far from help.

playing.title: Farm through Vorpal Blade
playing.detail: Use Q (Vorpal Blade, 6-4s cooldown) on cooldown for the life-tap sustain — this is how you survive to your item spikes, not how you win early trades.

playing.title: Scale toward split-push, not dueling
playing.detail: Shen's late kit is a map-pressure and teamfight tool, not a way to beat Mordekaiser 1v1. Once Titanic Hydra and boots are online, look to roam or split rather than force lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners and the 47.4%-over-175-games win rate are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability timings and trade-pattern reasoning are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Try to use Shen’s [P] to absorb Mordekaiser’s (Q) while engaging. Be careful of Mordekaiser’s (R) after reaching level 6 by keeping an eye out on your health.
